title: Isometric illustration / Production

location.series: IBM Design Language / public web guidelines
location.extent: Complete webpage content area, default interactive state

slide_intent: Translate a spatial style into repeatable construction steps so different makers can produce compatible perspective.
strategic_value: Explicit transforms and workspace settings can keep IBM isometric artwork aligned across illustration and animation tools.
demonstration: Illustrator settings, transformation tables, before-and-after geometry and cylinder steps lead into After Effects setup.
practical_value: Select the correct transform for a face direction and build rounded depth from grid-aligned cylinders.

content_islands.name: Workspace setup
content_islands.spec: Place the Illustrator preferences image below snapping instructions.

content_islands.name: Perspective transforms
content_islands.spec: Follow with automated and manual procedures, the 86.6% scaling table and before-and-after objects.

content_islands.name: Rounded depth
content_islands.spec: Use the rounded solid and numbered cylinder diagrams to explain construction.

content_islands.name: Animation setup
content_islands.spec: Finish with camera/null-object specifications, the After Effects screenshot and a lighting reminder.

reference_purposes.Intent: The introduction identifies technical construction difficulties and offers repeatable production guidance.
reference_purposes.Application: Step sequences and settings tables explain face transformations, cylinders and flattened camera perspective.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source calls for 8px-multiple bounding shapes, 86.6% vertical scale with direction-specific shear/rotation, and generally recommends against Illustrator 3D effects while naming exceptions.

ingredient.name: Isometric transforms
ingredient.role: Keep constructed faces and rounded depth on a shared projection.
ingredient.application: Use the face-specific scale, shear and rotation table; construct rounded depth from cylinders and retain the grid.
ingredient.scope: Production instructions for the documented Illustrator/After Effects workflow. Do not generalize these settings to every 3D rendering system.
